analyses.content: 录音中提到医院提供非常好的交通服务（transportation service），让病人可以免费（free of charge）乘车，对应题目中的Free transportation service。
你可能会因为听到“bus or train”而想填这两个具体的交通工具，但要注意空后有“service”一词，填写“transportation”才是对整体服务概念的准确概括。

The first question on the survey attempted to determine the main reason that patients choose to come to our hospital for treatment rather than others in the vicinity. The data showed that even though our hospital is not as centrally located as others, we offer a very good transportation service that enables patients to travel here by bus or train free of charge.
录音提到大多数病人（most patients）希望医院在他们就诊时是干净的（clean），对应题干的wished the hospital to be clean。
你可能会受到前面提到的“short waiting times”或“friendly service”的干扰，但录音用转折词“However”引出了大多数病人的真正期望，要注意听转折词后面的核心信息。

The second question on the survey asked what quality patients hoped for most when visiting the hospital. There were five choice options, including short waiting times and friendly service from nurses. However, the data collected showed that most patients hoped that the hospital is clean when they visit it.
录音指出病人非常渴望（very keen to）获得关于医院治疗的提前信息（prior information），对应题干的concerned about information。
录音先说了病人对标志和通知的清晰度“不感兴趣（not concerned）”，你如果不注意否定词“not”，很容易误填“signs”或“notices”。

It seemed that patients were not concerned with the clarity of signs and notices in the hospital, as this option got the smallest number of votes. They were, however, very keen to be given prior information by the staff about hospital treatments.
录音说明网站更新不仅是为了医务人员（medical staff），也是为了让当地居民（local residents）受益，对应题干的for local residents as well as hospital medical staff。
你可能会听到最后的“new patients”而产生动摇，但“patients”是希望吸引来的新群体，而网站直接服务的对象是明确并列的“medical staff”和“local residents”。

Using the data collected from our survey, we have developed a list of actions that will be adopted within the next year. A main focus of these improvements is our website, which is currently very outdated. We will not only update our in-hospital service for the use of the medical staff, but also our main service so that local residents can also benefit from it. We hope that this new service will attract a large number of new patients.
录音提到为了提高员工积极性，将实施一个系统，员工的成功工作将获得额外的奖金（extra bonus），直接对应题干。
你可能会将注意力放在“motivation”或“incentive”上，但这只是大方向的词，空前有“extra”作为明显的定位词，紧跟的“bonus”才是具体的奖励内容。

It is clear from the feedback that many members of staff are unhelpful towards patients and inefficient when carrying out their tasks. We feel that some incentive is needed to boost motivation to perform better, and so we are implementing a system whereby staff will be awarded an extra bonus for their success. The member of staff who has received the most bonuses at the end of the year will be announced as Staff Member of the Year.
录音明确指出，会将访客（visitors）的意见（opinions）不断纳入考虑（taken into consideration），完全对应题干结构。
你可能会听到“patient feedback forms”就想填“patients”，但录音后面紧接着明确说的是“opinions of our visitors”，填“visitors”才是最精准的同义替换。
We will continue to monitor progress on this issue through patient feedback forms so that the opinions of our visitors will constantly be taken into consideration.
录音中提到需要提高病人、医生和员工之间沟通（communication）的有效性（effectiveness），原词重现，完美对应题干。
你可能会因为听到前一句的“treatment”或后面的“ticketing system”而分心，但这道题句型结构和录音完全一致，只要顺着“effectiveness of”去听就能抓准。

Another issue that the survey has brought to light is the long delays experienced by visitors awaiting treatment, with some visitors reporting waiting times of up to five hours. This is unacceptable. We need to improve the effectiveness of communication between patients, doctors, and staff, so we have decided to implement a ticketing system. This means that patients are seen on a first come, first served basis and will never have to wait more than two hours to be seen by a doctor.
录音提到要为遭受睡眠障碍（sleep disturbance）的人建立一个新的病区（new unit），“suffering from”同义替换题干的“struggling with”。
你可能会因为忽略了空后的“disturbance”这个限定词，而去抓听后面的“illness”或“population”，要注意填空词和已知词组构成的固定搭配。

The final topic that I want to cover in the lecture is the recommendations that we have put forward for future improvements to the hospital. Firstly, we intend to be the first hospital in the country to build a new unit for those suffering from sleep disturbance, which is a relatively common illness affecting up to six percent of the population.
录音中提到不能忽视那些需要整形手术（plastic surgery）的病人带来的收入，因此提议建立新病房（new ward），“in need of”直接对应题干。
此处的语序和题干略有不同，录音先提到了“plastic surgery”随后才说“proposing a new ward”，你需要结合上下文的完整语义块进行回忆和定位。

Whilst we are a hospital primarily treating patients with illnesses and injuries, we cannot ignore the significant income that those in need of plastic surgery could bring to the hospital. We will, therefore, also be proposing a new ward to give patients access to this increasingly popular treatment.
录音明确表达了需要更有效的规划（effective planning）来提高效率（improve the efficiency），“more effective”对应题干的“A better”。
你可能会因为听到长句末尾的“communication”而想要填入，但前面37题已经考过这个词，且句子的核心主语是“planning is needed”。

After much discussion about the quality and suitability of our equipment, we have decided that it is advanced enough to cope with the treatments that we offer and that our spending should be directed to other areas where it will have a more significant impact. We feel that more effective planning is needed to improve the efficiency of the forms of communication that patients have with us.
